text:
How to Draw the Mandalorian and Grogu (ft. Artist Will Sliney) | Star Wars Illustrated
Join Star Wars Comic Artist Will Sliney as he creates an epic illustration of Din Djarin and Din Grogu’s adventures, including a breakdown of their lore and art tips like how to draw a Mandalorian helmet. 

00:00 - Introduction 
00:47 - Chapter 1: Laying out the Page
2:45 - Chapter 2: The Mandalorian
9:36 - Chapter 3: Grogu
12:23 - Chapter 4: Razor Crest 
13:22 - Final Image!
